desc:
🍗🍟 Welcome to Eating in Jollibee

Come hang out and enjoy a fun, casual dining experience inspired by one of the most loved fast-food restaurants in the Philippines.

This experience is currently in beta. You may notice bugs, unfinished features, or changes over time. If you run into any issues, please let us know, your feedback helps us make the game better for everyone.

Thank you for playing and supporting the project!

Join Our Group:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/34830573/Tara-Meryenda-Restaurant#!/about
